script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Psychological
Theme: ambition

Begin screenplay.

Title: The Hunger Within

INT. NEW YORK APARTMENT - NIGHT

ALEXANDER, a charismatic 35-year-old man, sits at his cluttered writing desk. The glow from the lamplight illuminates his focused face. He types furiously on his laptop.

ALEXANDER
(whispering to himself)
This is it. I'll finally make my mark on the world.

INT. NEW YORK APARTMENT - KITCHEN - DAY

Alexander pours himself a cup of coffee and checks his phone. A text from his agent:

AGENT (TEXT)
Alexander, I have good news. Your script "The Hunger Within" has been selected for the prestigious Sundance Film Festival.

Alexander stands there, frozen, eyes wide, unable to believe it. He texts his friend MAYA back:

ALEXANDER (TEXT)
Maya, you won't believe this. I've been accepted into Sundance!

INT. NEW YORK APARTMENT - LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Alexander sits on his couch with Maya, a warm, empathetic 30-year-old woman. They both celebrate with champagne.

MAYA
(raising her glass)
To you, Alexander. You deserve this.

ALEXANDER
(raising his glass)
To us, Maya. We've done this together.

They clink glasses and share a heartfelt laugh.

INT. NEW YORK APARTMENT - BEDROOM - MORNING

Alexander wakes up in a cold sweat, his face contorted in fear. He jumps out of bed and rushes to the bathroom mirror, his eyes darting between his reflection and the bathroom scale.

ALEXANDER
(to himself)
I've made it. But at what cost?

INT. NEW YORK APARTMENT - KITCHEN - DAY

Alexander paces around the kitchen, looking for something to eat. Maya enters, concern etched on her face.

MAYA
(gently)
Alexander, what's wrong? You've barely eaten anything in days.

ALEXANDER
(anxiously)
I can't help it, Maya. The weight of this success is consuming me. I need to be perfect, to prove myself.

MAYA
(firmly)
But at what cost? Your health? Your happiness?

Alexander looks at her, then back at the scale.

INT. NEW YORK APARTMENT - LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Alexander sits on the couch, staring at his laptop screen. He's lost the inspiration that once fueled him. He glances at Maya, who sits nearby, reading.

MAYA
(softly)
Alexander, you don't have to do this alone.

Alexander looks at her, then back at the screen. He types one last line, then closes the laptop.

ALEXANDER
(resigned)
I know. But sometimes, the hunger within is too powerful to resist.

INT. NEW YORK APARTMENT - BEDROOM - MORNING

Alexander wakes up, feeling refreshed. He stretches, smiles, and looks at himself in the mirror.

ALEXANDER
(whispering to himself)
I'm not defined by my success or my failure. I'm defined by who I am.

INT. NEW YORK APARTMENT - LIVING ROOM - DAY

Alexander and Maya sit on the couch, working on a new script together. They laugh, joke, and share ideas. They're not focused on success or failure. They're focused on each other and the joy of creating.

ALEXANDER
(smiling)
Maya, we're going to make something amazing together.

MAYA
(smiling back)
I couldn't agree more.

FADE OUT.

End screenplay.
